items:
30A Escapes presents… “Aqua Waters”, your perfect Seacrest Beach retreat! Relax in this large luxury escape featuring 5 suites, access to the incredible lagoon pool directly out the back door, and 7 bikes to explore 30A. The 3rd-floor balcony steals the show with cozy porch swings for endless fun. Pet-friendly, spacious, and just a short stroll to the beach, shops, and dining, “Aqua Waters” is designed for unforgettable memories. Learn more below… 👇

★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ 12,000 sq. ft. Lagoon Pool Right Outside the Back Door: Step out and dive into the aqua waters!
✔ Expansive 3 rd-Floor Balcony: Kick back on the oversized balcony with swings, and a TV—a great hangout for all.
✔ 5 Suites: Each of the 3 King, 1 Queen and 1 Bunk Room has a dedicated bathroom and unique features to accommodate everyone with ease.
✔ Professional Grilling Space featuring BIG GREEN EGG and Sink.
✔ Pet-Friendly: Bring your furry friend! Pets are welcome with approval and a fee.
✔ 2-Min Walk to Boutique Shops, Dining at Peddlers Pavilion in Seacrest community.
✔ Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach: Take the tram for convenient seasonal beach access, which is just a 7-minute walk away.
✔ 7 Bikes for Exploring: Explore the scenic 30A area with adult beach bikes included.
✔ Rosemary and Alys Beach Proximity: Within a short distance to the iconic neighboring communities and their stunning beaches.

Eager to Read More?
Here Are A Few Kind Words from Our Previous Guests:

⭐ “Perfect location, spacious rooms, and our family loved the 3rd-floor deck by the pool.” – Joshua G.
⭐ “Everything about this property was PERFECT! A clean and wonderful home close to the best beach spots!” – Michael D.
⭐ “Our teens loved riding bikes, playing ping pong, and relaxing at the beach. Great for families!” – Susan B.

★☆ LIVING AREA ☆★

Relax in the open-concept living space with beach-inspired decor, hardwood floors, and natural sunlight. The plush sectional and cozy armchairs make it the perfect spot to unwind, while large windows offer views of the iconic lagoon pool.
✔ Spacious sectional sofa and armchairs
✔ Large Smart TV
✔ Direct access to the back patio overlooking the lagoon pool

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

Cook up delicious meals in the fully equipped gourmet chef’s kitchen featuring high-end appliances, ample counter space, and a custom dining table. A large kitchen island with additional bar seating makes it easy to gather for meals or drinks.

✔ Fully equipped gourmet kitchen and kitchen bar
✔ Custom dining table for 8 + bar seating for 4
✔ Outdoor grilling area with ample counter space, Big Green Egg, and sink setup

★☆ OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ☆★

1st-floor Patio with Direct Pool Access
Step outside the back door and take advantage of direct access to the 12,000 square feet Lagoon Pool. Perfect for cooling off on a hot summer day or soaking up the Florida sunshine, the patio makes it easy to dive straight into vacation mode.

✔ Front porch with outdoor seating
✔ Grilling Prep Space
✔ Direct Lagoon Pool access

3rd-Floor Balcony

The expansive 3rd-floor balcony is the ultimate hangout spot. Relax on the porch swings and enjoy the wet bar and TV for evening entertainment. It’s the perfect space to unwind and enjoy the views.

✔ Gorgeous pool views from 3rd-floor balcony
✔ 2 Large Bed Swings
✔ Wet bar
✔ Smart TV
✔ Sun loungers and Outdoor furniture
✔ Dining area for 6

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

1st Floor:
✔ Queen Bedroom: Flat-screen TV and dedicated bathroom with glass-enclosed shower

2nd Floor:
✔ Primary Suite 1: King bed, private balcony with lagoon views, flat-screen TV, en suite with garden tub, glass shower, double vanity, and large walk-in closet
✔ Primary Suite 2: King bed, flat-screen TV, closet, en suite with single vanity, glass shower, and large walk-in closet
✔ Bunk Room: 3 Twin-over-Twin bunk beds, EACH with a Personal TV+, custom built-in closet, and en suite with double vanities and shower/tub combo

3rd Floor:
✔ Primary Suite 3: King bed, built-in Twin-over-Twin bunk bed, large walk-in closet, flat-screen TV, balcony access, en suite with garden tub, glass shower, and double vanity

★☆ LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ☆★

Nestled in the vibrant Seacrest Beach community between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, "Aqua Waters" is a charming retreat that perfectly blends relaxation and convenience. With included bikes, exploring nearby attractions is a breeze.

✔ Lagoon Pool – A 12,000 sq. ft. paradise Directly Out the Back Door, featuring a zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungers.
✔ Beach Access – Seasonal tram service makes getting to the beach easy, perfect for carrying your gear.
✔ Peddler’s Pavilion – A quick 2-minute walk to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlife.
✔ Rosemary Beach – Only a 10-minute walk to this scenic coastal destination.
✔ Alys Beach – Just a 9-minute walk for picturesque views and charming experiences.
✔ Scenic Walking and Nature Trails – Explore beautiful trails just steps away.
✔ Bike-Friendly Community – Enjoy the included bikes for easy access to nearby spots.
✔ Outdoor Amenities – Relax with outdoor seating, loungers, picnic tables, and a grill station.
✔ South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes – A unique natural feature of this stunning area.

★☆ PET POLICY ☆★

✔ Non shedding, housebroken dogs only
✔ Pets are not allowed on furniture or beds
✔ Must be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dog
✔ Requires a non-refundable pet fee of $250 + tax

★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.
✔ There are active Ring doorbell cameras on the front and back patios.

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★
